headline.en: Open stem corpus, low-cost spatial audio network, and neural plate reverb estimation
headline.zh: 开放分轨数据集、低成本空间音频网络与神经板混响估计

summary.en: This week adds three papers: SPDMX, an openly licensed multitrack stem corpus rendered from public-domain symbolic scores, Ananas, a networked audio system for distributed spatial rendering on low-cost hardware, and two neural networks that estimate modal plate reverb parameters from impulse responses. No source projects were added.
summary.zh: 本周新增三篇论文：基于公有领域乐谱渲染的开放多轨分轨数据集 SPDMX；面向低成本硬件的分布式空间音频网络系统 Ananas；以及从冲激响应估计板混响模态参数的两种神经网络。本周没有新增源码项目。

note.en: SPDMX provides 253,982 songs and 490,159 mono stems with paired MIDI and an open rendering pipeline, giving stem-separation and source-separation research a large openly licensed dataset.
note.zh: SPDMX 提供 253,982 首歌曲和 490,159 条单声道分轨，配有对齐 MIDI 和开放渲染流程，为分轨与音源分离研究提供大规模开放许可数据。

note.en: Ananas offers protocols, control software, and microcontroller firmware for wave field synthesis and higher-order ambisonics on low-cost Faust-programmed boards synchronized via PTP.
note.zh: Ananas 提供协议、控制软件与微控制器固件，可在经 PTP 同步的低成本 Faust 开发板上实现波场合成与高阶 Ambisonics。

note.en: Two count-density networks jointly estimate modal count and per-mode frequency, decay, and gain from plate-reverb impulse responses, outperforming classical baselines on the challenge set.
note.zh: 两种计数密度网络从板混响冲激响应中联合估计模态数量及各模态的频率、衰减与增益，在挑战赛测试集上优于经典基线。
